name: social-platform-workspace
description: Agent orchestration workspace for the Social Platform polyrepo

scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d iam-postgres media-postgres social-postgres redis minio jaeger media-service media-worker
scripts.infra:down: docker compose stop iam-postgres media-postgres social-postgres redis minio jaeger media-service media-worker
scripts.backend:up: docker compose up -d --build gateway iam-service media-service social-service media-worker
scripts.backend:down: docker compose stop gateway iam-service media-service social-service media-worker
scripts.backend:build: docker compose build gateway iam-service media-service social-service media-worker
scripts.backend:restart: docker compose up -d --build --force-recreate gateway iam-service media-service social-service media-worker
scripts._comment_data_destroy: Destructive command intentionally disabled: docker compose down -v --remove-orphans
